notes: Address given with no street suffix ('45 East 89th'). Correct = capture the street ('45 East 89th St'); on the UES 'East 89th' unambiguously means Street. Watch for the address being dropped because no St/Ave is present.

input.subject: Prewar 3BR Co-op | Upper East Side | Co-broke Welcome
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Excited to bring a beautiful prewar co-op to market at 45 East 89th, right off the park on the Upper East Side.

3BR/2BA, high beamed ceilings, original hardwood floors, and a windowed eat-in kitchen. The building is a well-run prewar with a live-in super and low maintenance.

Ask: $2,850,000

Happy to co-broke. Reach out for the full setup and to schedule a private showing.

Best,
Danielle Kessler
Licensed RE Salesperson | Corcoran
